reset_semantics.instrumentation_previous_update_buffer: Retained only for read-only historical alignment measurement; never consumed by scientific computation.

reset_semantics.reset_target: All five temporary candidate-layer mlp.down_proj fast-weight tensors
reset_semantics.sample_start_state: The immutable checkpoint self.down_proj.weight for the current loaded model
